title: Aligning with Human Judgement: The Role of Pairwise Preference in Large Language Model Evaluators

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the misalignment between LLM-generated evaluation scores and human judgments by comparing their posterior predictive distributions (score histograms) and measuring performance using Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Spearman correlations.

Evaluating the impact of order sensitivity in pairwise comparisons by measuring the change in correlation with human judgments when applying a calibration method that averages the probabilities of both permutations of candidate pairs (A vs. B and B vs. A).
